cs.id AS id, cs.resident_id AS residentId, cs.doctor_id AS doctorId, cs.status AS status, cs.created_at AS createdAt, ru.real_name AS residentName, ru.username AS residentUsername, du.real_name AS doctorName, du.username AS doctorUsername, d.title AS doctorTitle, d.department AS doctorDepartment, d.expertise_tags AS doctorExpertise, d.rating AS doctorRating, (SELECT m.content FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT m.created_at FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT m.sender FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastSender, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS messageCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id AND m.sender <> #{mySender} AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadCount
FROM consult_session cs LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = cs.resident_id LEFT JOIN sys_user du ON du.id = cs.doctor_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = cs.doctor_id
mapper.select:
SELECT du.id AS doctorId, du.real_name AS doctorName, du.username AS doctorUsername, d.department AS department, d.title AS title, d.expertise_tags AS expertiseTags, d.rating AS rating, d.current_load AS currentLoad, cs.id AS sessionId, (SELECT m.content FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT m.created_at FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS messageCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id AND m.sender = 'DOCTOR' AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadCount FROM sys_user du JOIN doctor d ON d.id = du.id LEFT JOIN consult_session cs ON cs.id = (SELECT MAX(cs2.id) FROM consult_session cs2 WHERE cs2.resident_id = #{residentId} AND cs2.doctor_id = du.id AND cs2.consult_type = 'DOCTOR' AND cs2.status = 'OPEN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs2.id)) WHERE du.is_deleted = 0 AND du.role = 'DOCTOR' AND du.status = 1 AND d.audit_status = 'APPROVED'
AND cs.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lastMessageAt DESC, d.rating DESC, du.id

SELECT du.id AS doctorId, du.real_name AS doctorName, du.username AS doctorUsername, d.department AS department, d.title AS title, d.expertise_tags AS expertiseTags, d.rating AS rating, d.current_load AS currentLoad, cs.id AS sessionId, (SELECT m.content FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT m.created_at FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS messageCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id AND m.sender = 'DOCTOR' AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadCount FROM sys_user du JOIN doctor d ON d.id = du.id LEFT JOIN consult_session cs ON cs.id = (SELECT MAX(cs2.id) FROM consult_session cs2 WHERE cs2.resident_id = #{residentId} AND cs2.doctor_id = du.id AND cs2.consult_type = 'DOCTOR' AND cs2.status = 'OPEN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs2.id)) WHERE du.is_deleted = 0 AND du.role = 'DOCTOR' AND du.status = 1 AND d.audit_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN cs.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, lastMessageAt DESC, d.rating DESC, du.id
